tolerance: Exact typed-value/IEEE-754 bits and full table output-model equality, no tolerance. Same returned Core result, including identical elapsed time in assertions. Only exported timing cells normalize to a volatile marker for stable corpus hashes. Expected Framework exceptions rehydrate XML-normalized LF to CRLF; raw message hashes retained. Rejections/synthetic API records are not successful statistical parity.
hashing: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, comma/colon separators. Ordered typed columns preserve original attribute/text strings, category CLR types, hexadecimal Double bits and source lists without parsing/rounding. Per-presentation identical panels share canonical hashes; large tables retain every typed row hash plus header/representative cells. Full exact cell comparisons execute before export; raw XML hashes and private TRX preserve provenance.
